Visualizing the results from the mixture model
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)

results_final <- read.table("output_files/results_final.txt", header = TRUE, sep = '\t')

```


Calculating each of the histone marks coverage in the different cell types based on the results from the mixture modeling
```{r}
coverage <- function(col) {
  sum(results_final[[col]]) / nrow(results_final) * 100
}

coverage_cols <- c(
  "p10_k4me1_signal", "p10_k27me3_signal", "p10_k36me3_signal",
  "MII_k4me1_signal", "MII_k27me3_signal",
  "MII_k36me3_signal", "MII_k4me3_signal"
)

collected_coverage_df <- tibble(
  cellandmark = coverage_cols,
  percentage  = sapply(coverage_cols, coverage),
  mark = c("k4me1", "k27me3", "k36me3",
           "k4me1", "k27me3", "k36me3", "k4me3")
)

print(collected_coverage_df)

ggplot(collected_coverage_df,
       aes(x = fct_rev(cellandmark),
           y = percentage,
           fill = mark)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percentage, 1)),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Genome coverage (%)") +
  theme_minimal()

```
Defining different categories of the genome to investigate the transition from p10 to MII oocytes
```{r}

# all categories
results_final <- results_final %>%
  mutate(
    p10_profile_all = case_when(
      p10_k4me1_signal == 0 & p10_k27me3_signal == 0 & p10_k36me3_signal == 0 ~ "no marks",
      p10_k4me1_signal == 0 & p10_k27me3_signal == 1 & p10_k36me3_signal == 0 ~ "k27me3 only",
      p10_k4me1_signal == 0 & p10_k27me3_signal == 0 & p10_k36me3_signal == 1 ~ "k36me3 only",
      p10_k4me1_signal == 0 & p10_k27me3_signal == 1 & p10_k36me3_signal == 1 ~ "k27me3 + k36me3",
      p10_k4me1_signal == 1 & p10_k27me3_signal == 0 & p10_k36me3_signal == 0 ~ "k4me1 only",
      p10_k4me1_signal == 1 & p10_k27me3_signal == 1 & p10_k36me3_signal == 0 ~ "k4me1 + k27me3",
      p10_k4me1_signal == 1 & p10_k27me3_signal == 0 & p10_k36me3_signal == 1 ~ "k4me1 + k36me3",
      TRUE ~ "k4me1 + k27me3 + k36me3"
    )
  )

# firstplot
results_final <- results_final %>%
  mutate(
    p10_profile_firstplot = case_when(
      p10_k4me1_signal == 1 ~ "k4me1",
      TRUE ~ "no k4me1"
    )
  )

# second plot
results_final <- results_final %>%
  mutate(
    p10_profile_secondplot = case_when(
      p10_k4me1_signal == 1 & p10_k27me3_signal == 0 ~ "k4me1 only",
      p10_k4me1_signal == 1 & p10_k27me3_signal == 1 ~ "k4me1 + k27me3",
      p10_k4me1_signal == 0 & p10_k27me3_signal == 1 ~ "k27me3 only",
      TRUE ~ "no k4me1 or k27me3"
    )
  )

# third plot
results_final <- results_final %>%
  mutate(
    p10_profile_thirdplot = case_when(
      p10_k4me1_signal == 1 & p10_k36me3_signal == 0 ~ "k4me1 only",
      p10_k4me1_signal == 1 & p10_k36me3_signal == 1 ~ "k4me1 + k36me3",
      p10_k4me1_signal == 0 & p10_k36me3_signal == 1 ~ "k36me3 only",
      TRUE ~ "no k4me1 or k36me3"
    )
  )


# MII categories

  mutate(
    MII_profile_all = case_when(
      # no k4me1
      MII_k4me1_signal == 0 & MII_k27me3_signal == 0 & MII_k36me3_signal == 0 & MII_k4me3_signal == 0 ~ "no marks",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 0 & MII_k27me3_signal == 1 & MII_k36me3_signal == 0 & MII_k4me3_signal == 0 ~ "k27me3 only",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 0 & MII_k27me3_signal == 0 & MII_k36me3_signal == 1 & MII_k4me3_signal == 0 ~ "k36me3 only",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 0 & MII_k27me3_signal == 0 & MII_k36me3_signal == 0 & MII_k4me3_signal == 1 ~ "k4me3 only",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 0 & MII_k27me3_signal == 1 & MII_k36me3_signal == 1 & MII_k4me3_signal == 0 ~ "k27me3 + k36me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 0 & MII_k27me3_signal == 1 & MII_k36me3_signal == 0 & MII_k4me3_signal == 1 ~ "k27me3 + k4me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 0 & MII_k27me3_signal == 0 & MII_k36me3_signal == 1 & MII_k4me3_signal == 1 ~ "k36me3 + k4me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 0 & MII_k27me3_signal == 1 & MII_k36me3_signal == 1 & MII_k4me3_signal == 1 ~ "k27me3 + k36me3 + k4me3",
      
      # with k4me1
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k27me3_signal == 0 & MII_k36me3_signal == 0 & MII_k4me3_signal == 0 ~ "k4me1 only",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k27me3_signal == 1 & MII_k36me3_signal == 0 & MII_k4me3_signal == 0 ~ "k4me1 + k27me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k27me3_signal == 0 & MII_k36me3_signal == 1 & MII_k4me3_signal == 0 ~ "k4me1 + k36me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k27me3_signal == 0 & MII_k36me3_signal == 0 & MII_k4me3_signal == 1 ~ "k4me1 + k4me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k27me3_signal == 1 & MII_k36me3_signal == 1 & MII_k4me3_signal == 0 ~ "k4me1 + k27me3 + k36me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k27me3_signal == 1 & MII_k36me3_signal == 0 & MII_k4me3_signal == 1 ~ "k4me1 + k27me3 + k4me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k27me3_signal == 0 & MII_k36me3_signal == 1 & MII_k4me3_signal == 1 ~ "k4me1 + k36me3 + k4me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k27me3_signal == 1 & MII_k36me3_signal == 1 & MII_k4me3_signal == 1 ~ "all marks"
    )
  )


#first plot
results_final <- results_final %>%
  mutate(
    MII_profile_firstplot = case_when(
      # no k4me1
      MII_k4me3_signal == 1 ~ "k4me3",
      TRUE ~ "no k4me3"
    )
  )

#secondplot
results_final <- results_final %>%
  mutate(
    MII_profile_secondplot = case_when(
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k27me3_signal == 0 ~ "k4me1 only",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k27me3_signal == 1 ~ "k4me1 + k27me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 0 & MII_k27me3_signal == 1 ~ "k27me3 only",
      TRUE ~ "no k4me1 or k27me3"
    )
  )

#thirdplot
results_final <- results_final %>%
  mutate(
    MII_profile_thirdplot = case_when(
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k36me3_signal == 0 ~ "k4me1 only",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 1 & MII_k36me3_signal == 1 ~ "k4me1 + k36me3",
      MII_k4me1_signal == 0 & MII_k36me3_signal == 1 ~ "k36me3 only",

```

Pie charts to illuminate the size of the different categories, here using all possible categories
```{r}
# all categories
p10_profile_table <- as.data.frame(table(results_final$p10_profile_all))
pie(p10_profile_table$Freq, labels = p10_profile_table$Var1, main = "P10 profile")
MII_profile_table <- as.data.frame(table(results_final$MII_profile_all))
pie(MII_profile_table$Freq, labels = MII_profile_table$Var1, main = "MII profile")
```

Alluvial plots showing the transition from p10 to MII oocytes, here with different categories for easier interpretation
```{r}
#using a subset of the dataset for easier computation
results_final_subset <- results_final[sample(nrow(results_final), 5000), ]


results_final_subset %>%
  mutate(freq = 1, p10_profile_all = factor(p10_profile_all,levels = c("no marks", "k27me3 only", "k27me3 + k36me3", "k36me3 only", "k4me1 + k36me3", "k4me1 + k27me3 + k36me3", "k4me1 + k27me3","k4me1 only")),
        MII_profile_all = factor(MII_profile_all, levels = c("no marks", "k27me3 only", "k27me3 + k36me3", "k36me3 only", "k27me3 + k4me3","k36me3 + k4me3","k4me3 only", "k27me3 + k36me3 + k4me3", "k4me1 + k4me3", "k4me1 + k36me3 + k4me3","k4me1 + k36me3","k4me1 + k27me3 + k4me3","k4me1 + k27me3 + k36me3","k4me1 + k27me3","k4me1 only","all marks"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = p10_profile_all,
             axis2 = MII_profile_all,
             y = freq)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = p10_profile_all)) +
  geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  theme_minimal()

results_final_subset %>%
  mutate(freq = 1, p10_profile_all = factor(p10_profile_all,levels = c("no marks", "k27me3 only", "k27me3 + k36me3", "k36me3 only", "k4me1 + k36me3", "k4me1 + k27me3 + k36me3", "k4me1 + k27me3","k4me1 only")),
         MII_profile_all = factor(MII_profile_all, levels = c("no marks", "k36me3 only", "k27me3 + k36me3", "k27me3 only", "k27me3 + k4me3","k36me3 + k4me3","k4me3 only", "k27me3 + k36me3 + k4me3", "k4me1 + k4me3", "k4me1 + k36me3 + k4me3","k4me1 + k36me3","k4me1 + k27me3 + k4me3","k4me1 + k27me3 + k36me3","k4me1 + k27me3","k4me1 only","all marks"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = MII_profile_all,
             axis2 = p10_profile_all,
             y = freq)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = MII_profile_all)) +
  geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  theme_minimal()



#firstplot
results_final_subset %>%
  mutate(freq = 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = p10_profile_firstplot,
             axis2 = MII_profile_firstplot,
             y = freq)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = p10_profile_firstplot)) +
  geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  theme_minimal()

#secondplot
results_final_subset %>%
  mutate(freq = 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = p10_profile_secondplot,
             axis2 = MII_profile_secondplot,
             y = freq)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = p10_profile_secondplot)) +
  geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  theme_minimal()

#thirdplot
results_final_subset %>%
  mutate(freq = 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = p10_profile_thirdplot,
             axis2 = MII_profile_thirdplot,
             y = freq)) +
```

Percentage of MII k4me3 positive bins that were k4me1 positive in p10
```{r}
nrow(results_final[results_final$p10_k4me1_signal == 1 & results_final$MII_k4me3_signal == 1, ])/nrow(results_final[results_final$MII_k4me3_signal == 1, ])*100
```
Percentage of P10 k4me1 positive bins that become MII k4me3 positive bins
```{r}
nrow(results_final[results_final$p10_k4me1_signal == 1 & results_final$MII_k4me3_signal == 1, ])/nrow(results_final[results_final$p10_k4me1_signal == 1, ])*100
```
